puzzle.hint: A celebrated verse praising the noble traits of patience and forgiveness — it describes them as a hallmark of firm resolve and strong character.
puzzle.arabic: وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ
puzzle.verseEn: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [worthy] of resolve.
